author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕುಸುಮದಲಿ ಮಧುವನ್ನು ಮಕ್ಷಿಕವು ಸೆಳೆವಂತೆ
ಹಸಿವಿರಲು ವಿದ್ಯೆಗಳ ಬಲ್ಲರಿಂ ಪಡೆವೆ
ತುಸುಬಾಗಿ ಶರಣಾಗಿ ವಿನಯದಿಂ ಕಲಿಯುತಿರೆ
ಹೊಸಬದುಕ ಕಟ್ಟುವೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: As the bee draws honey from the flower,
if you are hungry, you will gain learning from those who know;
if you bend a little, surrender, and keep learning with humility,
you will build a new life, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A hungry learner, like a bee seeking nectar, draws knowledge from the wise. Humility and openness make it possible to rebuild one’s life.
